heroDescription: Your central hub for staff rules, training, guides, and procedures.
announcementText: Important updates from Georgia State Roleplay Management.
rulesIntro: Staff rules and expectations for the Georgia State Roleplay staff team.
guidesIntro: Helpful guides for common staff responsibilities.
trainingIntro: Build the knowledge and judgment needed to become an effective staff member.
proceduresIntro: Use consistent procedures when handling staff situations.

rules.title: Professional Conduct
rules.text: Remain respectful and professional when interacting with players, staff members, and community members.

rules.title: Staff Activity
rules.text: Maintain reasonable activity and communicate with management if you will be unavailable for an extended period.

rules.title: Communication
rules.text: Use the appropriate staff channels for staff matters. Keep internal discussions professional.

rules.title: Staff Permissions
rules.text: Only use staff permissions when they are necessary for your duties. Never use administrative tools for personal advantage.

rules.title: Punishments
rules.text: Base moderation decisions on the applicable rules and available evidence. Punishments should be fair and consistent.

rules.title: Confidentiality
rules.text: Keep internal staff information, reports, investigations, and private discussions within appropriate staff areas.

rules.title: Staff Abuse
rules.text: Abuse or misuse of staff powers may result in disciplinary action.

rules.title: Chain of Command
rules.text: Use the staff chain of command when escalating issues. Do not bypass management without a valid reason.

guides.title: Moderation Guide
guides.text: Identify the applicable rule, gather context, communicate clearly, and document significant actions.

guides.title: Session Guide
guides.text: Confirm staffing, understand your assignment, and stay attentive during sessions.

guides.title: Ticket Guide
guides.text: Read the request carefully, collect relevant information, and resolve or escalate it.

guides.title: Discord Guide
guides.text: Use the correct staff channels and keep internal discussions organized.

guides.title: ER:LC Guide
guides.text: Stay visible, monitor situations, and prioritize fair roleplay and player safety.

guides.title: Staff Commands
guides.text: Document approved staff commands and use them only within your assigned permissions.

training.title: Community Rules
training.text: Learn the rules staff are responsible for enforcing.

training.title: Moderation
training.text: Learn how to properly handle violations and make fair decisions.

training.title: Staff Commands
training.text: Learn approved staff commands and when they should be used.

training.title: Procedures
training.text: Learn how to handle common staff situations.

procedures.title: Handling Rule Violations
steps: Gather enough context to make a fair decision.

procedures.title: Staff Reports
steps: Do not handle a report where you have a conflict of interest.
Send the report to the appropriate management member.

procedures.title: Appeals
steps: Review the original action and evidence.

procedures.title: Escalation
steps: Know when an issue is beyond your authority.
